text.en: This Order may be cited as the Preservation of Books Act (Amendment) Order. 2018 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st March 2016. Amendment of section 2 of Chapter 125

Section 2 of the Preservation of Books Act is amended, in the definition of "the Director", by deleting "Museums" and by substituting "Language and Literature Bureau" therefor. Made this 29th. day of Zulhijjah, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 10th. day of September, 2018 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan. Brunei Darussalam. AND YANG.DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
